versions.localizedDescription: Lyrics are now in time, Arabic lyrics fixed, mixed Arabic/English lines in the right order. Lyrics made for the exact version that plays, so lines no longer run early or late; small jumps back are smoothed. Arabic lyrics in the song's own script are preferred. Mixed Arabic and English lines show in the right reading order. Words light up at a natural pace when a song only has line timing. New since 14.0.2: Device Connect on iPhone and iPad: see, control and move what Lahn plays on your Mac, PC and Android phone. Based on Metrolist main up to 2c0d94a38.

Faster song start, animated lyrics with the Fluid background and ambient mode, sync with your YouTube Music account, Daily Lahn mix with 'Why this song?', widgets, Siri and lots of fixes from Metrolist.
Lahn stays in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen after a Scan, all of Metrolist's latest fixes (14.0.1), and no more donation pop-up.
Smarter Talk to Lahn, playlist organizer, faster AI, playlists saved to YouTube Music, one shared Scanned Music, reliable iPad scan results.
Fixes Lahn closing when you scan from Control Center while music is playing. The song now stays in the Dynamic Island for a few seconds.
Fixes the crash when opening Library with a big music library (1000+ songs). Lahn also stays open if something fails in the background.
First Lahn for iPhone and iPad: Shazam-style Lahn Scan from Control Center and widgets, Equalizer, Listen Together, Talk to Lahn.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Lahn uses the local network to find nearby devices for Device Connect and casting.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lahn listens for a few seconds to name the song that's playing around you, then saves it to Scanned Music.
